title: Flexible Inference for Winners with Conditional Validity
summary: Researchers often select top-performing options or winners, based on a data-driven criterion, such as treatments, models, or model features and then report effect estimates for the selected winners. Naive post-selection estimates, however, are known to suffer from the winner's curse, producing systematically overoptimistic results. We introduce a flexible conditional inference method that corrects for this overoptimism through an adaptive exponential randomization scheme.
